info.title: Webby.WsGateway
info.description:
Webby WebSocket Gateway provides real-time chat messaging capabilities using Socket.IO.

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites
1. **Authentication Token**: Obtain a WebSocket token from the REST API endpoint `/api/ws-token`
2. **Chat ID**: The UUID of the chat room you want to join

### Connection URL
**Development:** `ws://localhost:5000/?token=<TOKEN>&chat_id=<CHAT_ID>` (in postman set v2 of web socket in properties tab)

### Connection Flow
1. Client requests WebSocket token from /api/ws-token (REST API)
2. Server returns one-time token
3. Client initiates WebSocket connection with token and chat_id query parameters
4. Server validates token and chat_id
5. On success: Client joins the chat room and can send/receive messages. On failure: Connection is rejected with error message

## WebSocket Events

### 1. `QUEUE_UPDATED`
Notifies all room members that the room queue has been updated.

**Payload:**
```json
{
  "position": [1, 6]
}
```

**Use Case:**
After receiving the position of an added or deleted item, the client can check if that position is currently in view. If so, the client should refresh the queue list using `GET /api/rooms/{id}/queue`.

## Notes ##

 - You will not send anything through the Socket.io. It serves only for notifying clients about events.
